izzyondroid:eu.basicairdata.clinometer.description:
Basic Air Data Clinometer is a simple App to measure your device’s inclination angles with respect to gravity’s direction using the onboard accelerometers. It is a basic and lightweight App with geometric-inspired graphics that can be used as Clinometer or Bubble Level. It is intended to measure, not store data.
 A „Getting Started“ guide can be found here . IMPORTANT NOTE: Please go to Settings and calibrate it before use. The measurement’s precision mainly depends on the accuracy of the calibration: use a good horizontal and vertical reference.
 USAGES: 
 Bubble Level (horizontal)
 Clinometer (vertical)
 Measure with the Camera (vertical only)
 MEASUREMENT: 
 X (Yellow) = The angle between the horizontal plane and the horizontal axis of the screen
 Y (Yellow) = The angle between the horizontal plane and the vertical axis of the screen
 Z (Yellow) = The angle between the horizontal plane and the axis that comes out perpendicular to the screen
 Pitch (White) = The angle between the contour line (inclined, white) and the reference axis (horizontal or vertical, dashed white) on the screen plane
 Roll (White) = The angle between the screen and the horizontal plane

fdroid:com.erfangholami.solidshare.name: Solid Share
fdroid:com.erfangholami.solidshare.summary: Files, contacts and passes on your own Solid pod, shared on your terms
fdroid:com.erfangholami.solidshare.description:
Solid Share brings the Solid ecosystem to everyday Android users. Sign in with your Solid pod and use it as a personal data wallet: browse your files, keep your address book and your passes on it, share any of it with the people you choose, and let other Solid apps reach it on terms you set.
Solid is an open web standard for personal data stores, called pods. Your pod is yours — pick a provider or run your own. Solid Share has no server: the app talks to your pod directly, and nothing you store passes through us.
HOME
* What changed while you were away: unread notifications, access requests, and the files you opened or that changed
* Your next pass, what you shared, and what has been shared with you, on one screen
* It tells you when you are offline, and how many changes are waiting to upload
FILES
* Browse containers and resources in list or grid, sorted by name, type or date
* Upload from device storage, or capture a photo or video and upload it straight away
* Images, PDFs and text open inside the app; anything else opens with the app of your choice
* Share any file from any app straight into your pod, one at a time or many at once
* Duplicate a file or folder as a private copy, reset to owner-only access
SHARING
* Grant a specific Solid user, by WebID, or anyone with the link, access to any file or folder
* View, Add and Edit access levels instead of raw Read, Append and Write
* Every share produces a QR code and a link that opens straight back into the app
* Two pod-backed lists: what you have shared, and what has been shared with you
* Widen, narrow or revoke a share at any time; the recipient is told when their access changes
* Ask an owner for access when a resource denies you, and answer requests yourself
* Works across Solid servers, using Web Access Control with an Access Control Policy fallback
APPS ON YOUR PHONE
* Other Solid apps reach your pod through Solid Share, so no other app holds your credentials
* You decide what each app may do — View, Add, Edit or Full access — and where: your whole pod, folders you choose, or just your contacts
* An Apps tab lists every app that has access, and narrows or removes it whenever you like
* Grants stay on your device and are never written to your pod
WALLET
* Event tickets, boarding passes, cinema tickets, loyalty cards and coupons, as ordinary Solid resources you own
* Apple Wallet .pkpass import, read in full, with the original file kept beside the ticket
* Barcodes re-rendered in the issuer's own symbology, so gate scanners read the identical code, with a brightness boost when you open one
* Passes carrying an issuer web service keep themselves current
* An open ticket-QR format, so any issuer can offer one-tap add-to-pod with no integration
CONTACTS
* Your address book on your pod, in the standard vCard vocabulary, round-tripped in full
* Two-way sync with the phone's Contacts app, one Android account per pod
* Import from the phone's own accounts or from a .vcf file, and export everything back out
* Near-duplicates are suggested for review and merged only when you say so, never silently
OFFLINE
* Everything you have seen is on the device, encrypted, and opens with no connection
* Every write queues and drains by itself when the connection comes back
* Pin a file to keep its content available offline
ACCOUNTS
* Log into several pods at once and switch between them
* Inrupt, Solid Community, Data Pod, or any custom OIDC issuer URL
* An expired session is a state, not a logout — reconnect in one tap, keeping your data in place
LANGUAGES
* English, German, Spanish, French and Italian
* The app follows your phone language, and you can pick a different one for Solid Share alone
Solid Share is free software under the MIT licence. It ships in two builds: the F-Droid build links no proprietary dependency at all, and the Google Play build adds crash reporting.
Source code: https://github.com/erfangholami/SolidShare

fdroid:com.vadimfrolov.duorem.summary: Wake up or shutdown remote computer from your phone/tablet.
fdroid:com.vadimfrolov.duorem.description:
The idea behind this app is to provide people who are not very familiar with
computer interfaces a simple and easy way to control a remote computer. Imagine
your grand parent needs a way to power a media server. Quick and efficiently!

need to make sure that your computer and network is set up for and support WOL.

Differences from similar apps
* Supports power off and power on signals.
* Controls only a single computer.
* Big interface controls for people with thick fingers.
* Remote computer status and commands feedback.
* Host search for easy first-time setup.
* Open source, no ads.

Free to start with Wave and one scene you pick. Full Unlock opens every scene.
REACTS TO WHAT'S PLAYING
Choose System Audio and the scenes follow what other apps play, such as a video or a streaming app. Pick System Audio from the microphone button's menu, then follow the steps on screen to start iOS's screen broadcast. Protected audio, such as Apple Music, can't be captured; use the microphone for it instead.
LIVE SOUND, TOO
Choose the microphone and the scenes respond to the music in the room: speakers, a record or a live set.
EVERY PART OF THE SOUND
Band levels, beat strength, kicks and snares, down to a fine spectrum. Each part of the sound turns into a line that sways, a light that flickers or a liquid that swells.
70+ SCENES. 10 STYLES.
• Line — waveforms and contour lines.
• Graphic — op art, geometric patterns and halftone dots.
• Wire — wireframe oceans and rolling landscapes.
• Raster — point clouds, particles and data-inspired forms.
• Lighting — stage lights, lasers and haze.
• Chroma — auroras, curtains and fields of color.
• Cyber — neon grids and retro-futuristic worlds.
• Metal — liquid chrome, foil and iridescent surfaces.
• Fluid — ferrofluid, lava, honey and liquids that heave and drip.
• Spectral — oscilloscopes, field lines and forms drawn from a fine spectrum.
SET THE SCENE FOR THE PARTY
Send the visuals to a TV or projector with AirPlay or a compatible display cable: the big screen shows the visuals while your device becomes the controller.
PRESS PLAY. LET IT RUN.
Shuffle keeps the scenes coming. Save your favorites and adjust speed and intensity — or, with Full Unlock, shuffle playlists of your own. Touch the canvas and the scene reacts at your fingertip, too.
With no sound coming in, Ambient Auto on the microphone button keeps the scenes moving (Ambient Auto plays no music). The screen stays awake while the app is in use.
SEE WHAT'S PLAYING
Show the artwork, title and artist of the song that's playing over the scene. LIQUIDWAVE reads the song playing in the Music app, or identifies what the mic or System Audio hears with Shazam. Either can be turned off in Settings. The song never shows on a TV or projector.
With Full Unlock, Mix Shuffle picks the scenes that suit the song. The Apple Intelligence model on your device sorts the track (iOS 26 or later, on a device with Apple Intelligence turned on).
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sound is analyzed on your device and is not recorded or uploaded. To identify a song, Shazam sends Apple only a signature made from the sound. No account, no tracking and no ads.
Wave and one scene you choose during the welcome tour are free. Buy once, or subscribe yearly — either one unlocks every scene and scene playlists on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

firefox-addons:2889399.name: Fraud Monitor - Browser Security
firefox-addons:2889399.summary: Blocks known scam sites before they load, and checks any message, phone number, image or link you are unsure about. The scam-site list is stored on your own device, so your everyday browsing never leaves your machine.
firefox-addons:2889399.description:
Fraud Monitor catches scams two ways: it blocks sites on our known-fraud list before your browser connects to them, and it gives you a scanner for anything else you are unsure about.
WHAT IT BLOCKS ON ITS OWN
Phishing pages, crypto and investment scams, pig butchering (the "wrong number" romance and trading setups), fake customer support and imposter brand sites, and known malicious links. When one is recognized you get a warning page instead of the scam. Family Alerts feature lets someone you trust know if you downloaded potentially dangerous software or site.
WHAT YOU CAN CHECK YOURSELF
Pin the blue Fraud Monitor shield to your toolbar, or open it in the sidebar for a larger view, and check:
 Text: paste a message, listing, email or DM
 Links: check a URL before you click it
 Phone numbers: spot known scam call centers and spoofed numbers
 Images: screenshots, QR codes and profile photos
 Fake Store Detection: check whether a store looks suspicious before entering your credit card
 Family Alerts: let someone you trust know if you downloaded potentially dangerous software or site
You can also select text on any page, right-click, and send it straight to Fraud Monitor.
HOW IT TREATS YOUR BROWSING
The scam-site list is compressed and stored on your own machine, so checking a page is a local lookup that sends nothing. Only when a site matches that local list do we confirm it with our server. Your ordinary browsing never leaves your device.
Access to all websites is an optional permission, not a required one. Fraud Monitor works without it. Granting it lets us stop a scam site before the connection is made, rather than warning you once the page has already started loading. You can turn it on or off whenever you like.
There is no account to create and no password to remember.
FREE AND SUBSCRIBER
Free - 100 scans a day, and the scam-site list refreshed weekly.
Subscriber ($2.00 per month) - 250 scans a day, and list updates in real time as new scam domains appear.
WHEN WE GET IT WRONG
Detection uses machine learning, and machine learning is not perfect. If we flag something harmless, or miss something we should have caught, tell us and we will look at it. Your reports are how the model gets better.

Stylish lets you style the web according to your personal taste.

If you know CSS, become a Youtube skins or Facebook theme creator - create and share styles for Facebook, Youtube, and other popular websites.
***Stylish Communities***
✔ Official: https://forum.userstyles.org 
✔ https://www.reddit.com/r/userstyles/ 
✔ https://www.tumblr.com/tagged/userstyles 
✔ https://github.com/UserStyles

・領収書や請求書の数字を素早く合計したい方
